methods.operator: nodal mole fraction A; alternative discretization

statistics.unit: case; average five draws within each case first
statistics.primary_multiplicity: Also Bonferroni two-sided intervals for all predeclared comparator final outputs; improvement only if adjusted upper bound <0

runtime_scope.neural: synchronized C0+C1 forward; excludes batch loading, final array writes and external projections
runtime_scope.classical: solver wall time including periodic recovery-checkpoint I/O; geometry setup and final array writes separate
runtime_scope.SART: CPU sparse CSR sweeps and conversion including periodic recovery I/O; no GPU allocation; CPU peak RSS recorded separately
runtime_scope.comparison: report scopes explicitly; scheduler wall time and complete worker wall time are also retained; no unqualified pure-compute speed ratio

supplementary_operator.SART: A interpolates nodal mole fraction; discrete approximation to frozen P(C); all evaluation projections use exact frozen P(C)

failure_disposition: fixed-budget exhaustion retained; no methods omitted; numerical failure blocks scoring pending explicit documented software diagnosis before labels
recovery: only verifiable software bug; preserve original logs and predictions; versioned amendment then regenerate affected outputs without parameter/metric/endpoint change
stopping_rule: after final score, no further training, checkpoint selection or tuning
